doc.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Starting his own record label
summary: He started his label in 1992 simply to record his own material, and has made 20 CDs.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: When did uh, when did you start your record label?
Okay, and uh was this–well, there’s an obvious reason for doing it–but was there any frustration with past dealings with, with other labels, or just the desire to, to get your own material out?
Yeah, it was, it was just a desire. There was no frustration.
It was desire to, to get my own material, to record my own material in the way that I wanted to...and uh...that was at the basis of it.
I know there’s been a history of artists doing this at various times. Mingus had Debut and, you know, any number of people. How many recordings have you, have you released to date?
Well, since uh ’92, I’ve made uh 20, 20 CDs.
